$comment: Byte-anchored source-defect corrections for the extract stage. Each correction fixes a formation/gloss defect that lives in the immutable source term-bank bytes (verified: the wrong string is present verbatim in data/sources/<source>/, not introduced by our extractor). Corrections are applied to the normalized GrammarPoint field AFTER extraction, so the locked source bytes and their SOURCE.lock digests stay untouched. Every correction is fail-closed: if its anchor is not found in the targeted field the build raises, so a silently drifted source can never ship an unverified edit. Scope rule (UGD-11c-C acceptance #2): correct ONLY where the right form is mechanically evidenced by the card's OWN examples/headword; never invent a rule. Findings whose fix would require invention, or that collide with UGD-11c's corpus-wide refutations, are NOT corrected here and are recorded in `documented_not_corrected` with a reason.

later_additions.note: One source-authoring inconsistency in 文法.apkg: the 〜によって（誤用） note drops によって from its second counterexample, marking the grammatical 「箸でご飯を食べます」 as an error while its sibling note teaching the identical 誤用 pair writes 「箸によってご飯を食べます」. Corrected to the sibling's form, which is what this card's own stated rule evidences.

provenance.corrected_note: 42 distinct byte-anchored corrections. Started from the 34 in-scope findings, collapsed duplicate findings on shared cards, added sibling headword-variant completeness fixes (same physical card indexed under multiple lookup forms), and added defects surfaced by the post-fix UGD-11c re-review on the corrected corpus (a repeated typo the original anchor under-scoped, plus two example-field defects on cards whose structure defect was already flagged). Every correction restores a form the card's own examples/headword/pattern-header already evidence; none invents a rule.

rereview.harness: UGD-11c review_runner.py (Bedrock global.anthropic.claude-opus-5, adaptive thinking, effort=high), one fresh isolated invocation per card
rereview.scope: the 33 corrected canonical points, re-reviewed against a corrected copy of the frozen unified dataset
rereview.outcome: every must-fix formation/example defect that is mechanically derivable from the card's own content is resolved; the only must-fix findings that remain are the classes this task documents as NOT auto-correctable: たって sense-2 (structure shared across senses; correct rule would be invented), について/についての 名詞［辞書形］ and てばかりはいられない 動詞［て形］＋て… (edewakaru house notation / double-marker lines that UGD-11c's corpus-wide adversarial second opinion already REFUTED and filed none of).
rereview.note: The re-review surfaced 6 defects the original 100-item cluster under-captured (a repeated しる the first anchor under-scoped, missing から/か in にほかならない・によらず structure examples, missing も and a stray の in example paraphrases, にほならない and 合格にできた example typos); all were added as byte-anchored corrections above.

corrections.replacement: ×箸によってご飯を食べます。
corrections.rationale: UGD-11b finding 1. Note 1647848745958 (〜によって（誤用）) and note 1647848690228 (〜によって) teach the SAME 誤用 pair, and the 誤用 note drops によって from the second counterexample: 「×箸でご飯を食べます。」 marks a GRAMMATICAL sentence as an error, since 手段の で is exactly the correct particle here. Both notes' shared first counterexample (×毎日、自転車によって学校へ行く。) is identical, and both state the same rule 単に手段の選択を表す場合には使わない, so the sibling note's own 「×箸によってご飯を食べます。」 is the form this card's rule evidences. Mechanically derivable from the card's own asserted rule plus its sibling's verbatim text; no rule is invented.
